options.name: display_name
options.description: The display name for the group.

options.name: error_on_missing
options.description: If set to True, the group is absent and any user management is expected, the module will fail. The group will not be created.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier or name of the group.

options.name: ignore_missing_users
options.description: Whether to ignore errors when specified users are not found.

options.name: nextcloud_path
options.description: Specify the nextcloud instance's location in the host. If not specified, the module will attempt to use the `nextcloud_path` var if it exists. In last resort, read the `NEXTCLOUD_PATH` environment variable on the ansible host.

options.name: php_runtime
options.description: Specify the php runtime used to run the occ tool. Can be an absolute or relative path if the runtime is available in the remote host PATH. If not specified, the module will attempt to use the `nextcloud_php_runtime` var if it exists, then the `NEXTCLOUD_PHP_RUNTIME` environment variable on the ansible host.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the group. Use 'present' to ensure the group exists, 'absent' to ensure it does not. Use 'append_users' to add users to the group without affecting existing members. Use 'remove_users' to remove users from the group without affecting other members.

options.name: users
options.description: A list of usernames to be added or removed from the group. When state is 'present', the module will match the exact list provided.
